anti_overlap: Do not adjudicate Zod parse semantics — strip versus passthrough, union narrowing, cross-field .refine() guards, default-value coercion — the schema-evolution lens owns all of it. Reference variant B's .default([]) only as a state the shape cannot distinguish, never as a parse behavior to be fixed.

Do not design or critique the canonicalization algorithm — transport stripping, case folding, remote-name fallbacks, blocking or matching strategy. The identity-resolution lens owns that. This lens' question is only whether the design binds to a name at all, however well normalized.

Do not design thresholds, sentinel items, alerting, not-measurable reporting semantics, or the per-entry status breakdown of an aggregated figure — the measurement-reporting and observational lenses own those. Name what cannot be distinguished after mixing; do not specify the report that would distinguish it.

Do not rule on who may amend a mapping, on amendment procedure, or on the authority of the record. The registration lens owns governance. The substitution question here is whether a stand-in may be dispensed and whether the record must declare it, not who signs off.

Do not propose last-confirmed timestamps, verification epochs or re-observation cadence — the observational lens owns staleness by epoch. This lens' equivalent is intake: the single moment when material is accepted and after which it can no longer be authenticated.

Do not propose cutting identity marks into the repositories themselves — GitHub topics, git notes, committed marker files. The timber-framing lens already owns reciprocal marks on both members, and this lens' voucher is deliberately the opposite move: a token DERIVED from the material and retained on the dispenser's own side, requiring no write access to the supplier.

Do not redefine the funded-attention metric, its weighting, its identity set as a policy question, or the 2026-05-20 window, and do not review Astro or TypeScript style, component structure, or build performance.
decision_lens: Run four tests in order, then price the result in one dispenser's labor. ONE: NAME OR SUBSTANCE. Delete the name from the record and ask what is left that identifies the material. If nothing survives, the mapping is a label on a jar, and every failure mode in the goal statement — rename, fork, split, archive — is a relabelling attack the design cannot see. TWO: THE ABSENCE PROCEDURE. Ask what the system does when the specified repository cannot be had. There are exactly three honest answers — refuse and say so, dispense a declared substitute that the record names as a substitute, or dispense silently — and a variant that cannot express the second is forced to choose between the first and the third. THREE: WHERE IS IT AUTHENTICATED. Walk the chain from the admin counter to the rendered page and mark the last point at which the material could still be checked against a real repository. Everything downstream of powdering is documentation reviewing documentation. FOUR: INERT BUT AUTHENTIC. Hold the mapping fixed and correct, then ask what still reads zero — the assay's marker set, the window, the checkout that exists on neither machine. A design that only defends against wrong mappings has defended against one of the two ways a genuine item reads zero. Then count the labor: one dispenser, 43 files already declaring a mapping, a strict prose gate over the content directory, and no crew. An authentication ritual that needs a human hand per batch is not a scheme, it is a wish.
distance_rationale: This is a dispensing craft, not a records discipline, not an instrument discipline, and not a joinery. Its unit of concern is neither an entry in a register nor a reading of a faint source nor a joint between two members: it is a name written in a prescription and the physical substance handed across the counter under that name. That gives it four questions none of the covered domains can ask. First, its identity problem is not two strings denoting one thing — it is ONE name denoting different substances depending on where the dispenser is standing and which century's text they were trained on, which is a different pathology from a collision and has a different remedy. Second, it has a formal doctrine of absence: when the specified drug cannot be had, the tradition names authorized substitutes and requires the substitution to be declared, so 'the drug is unavailable' is a procedure with a named outcome rather than an occasion for improvisation — nothing in registration, photometry, schema design, entity resolution, observability, or timber framing has a doctrine for what to dispense when the thing does not exist. Third, it authenticates the material rather than the documentation: you break the root and look at the cross-section, and no amount of correct labelling substitutes for that — where cross-catalogue identification matches one label against another and a land register asks who was allowed to amend the entry. Fourth, it keeps a voucher specimen: an immutable retained sample of the actual batch, so an identity claim can be re-adjudicated later against the substance. Note carefully how this differs from the timber lens's marks cut into both members: a mark must be CUT, requires write access to the other member, and can be forged or lost; a voucher is DERIVED from the material and retained on the dispenser's own shelf, requiring nothing of the supplier. The craft also owns two mechanisms with no analogue in the covered set: processing destroys evidence, so once a root is powdered no one can ever authenticate it again and the authentication must therefore happen at intake; and potency is assayed against marker compounds, so genuine material of the wrong chemotype assays as inert and reads as a true zero.
expected_isomorphisms: One drug name denoting a different plant in each province — brahmi, shankhpushpi, daruharidra all resolve to different source species by region and by text — corresponds to the same repository name resolving to a different substance per machine. Verified in this environment: ~/projects/solwend and ~/projects/Solwend both canon() to mistakeknot/solwend and share root commit a3a321bc, while ~/projects/uncrancher carries the unrelated root e88d83af. The trade name says one thing and the material says another, and only one of those two is checkable.

The retained voucher specimen corresponds to storing something derived from the repository's own substance — its root-commit SHA is the obvious candidate — beside or instead of the URL. It survives rename, transfer, org move and fork; it is identical across a fork (correctly, a fork is the same material lineage) and different across an unrelated repository with a confusingly similar name. This is precisely the plan's own central ambiguity: unc-rancher versus uncrancher is undecidable by name and decidable by root commit. None of A, B, C or D holds anything but a trade name.

Abhava pratinidhi dravya — the textually authorized substitute, dispensed only when named — corresponds to what a mapping should do when its repository is archived, made private, deleted, or split into two. All four variants can only be silently edited to point somewhere else, leaving no trace that a substitution ever occurred and no way for a reader to know they are looking at a stand-in.

Adulteration, substitution and absence are three distinct offences with three distinct remedies in the dispensary. They correspond to three states the metric must never collapse: a mapping pointing at the wrong repository, an array carrying an extra unrelated repository alongside the right one, and no mapping at all. Variant B's repos: z.array(url).default([]) (proto.cjs:23) is the dispensary handing over an empty packet that looks exactly like a filled prescription.

Powdering destroys the diagnostic characters, so authentication must happen at intake and never afterwards. This corresponds to the point in the handling chain where a mapping can still be checked against a real repository: at the admin counter, where src/pages/admin/edit/[collection]/[slug].astro:104 takes a bare <input type="url"> and the API already holds an Octokit client, versus at build time, versus never — because once ids.flatMap folds every declared repository into one day-set, the mixture cannot be unmixed.

A potency assay keyed to a marker compound reports inert for genuine material of a different chemotype. This corresponds directly to scripts/fidelity-dryrun.mjs:16-20, where commits count only if the author email is one of three listed identities: real, correctly-mapped work committed under a fourth identity — a work machine, a rewritten history, a co-author trailer — assays as inert and produces a confident zero that no schema variant can explain.

The label outliving the jar's contents corresponds to GitHub's rename redirects: a stored URL keeps resolving after the repository is renamed or transferred, and the freed name can be reclaimed by another account, so the mapping continues to resolve while pointing at different material. A still-resolving name is the most dangerous state in the dispensary, not the safest.

The pharmacopoeial monograph — the public standard against which any dispenser's material can be checked by anyone — corresponds to the requirement that the site publicly render what it measures. Today src/pages/projects/[slug].astro:137-142 renders a bare link behind a {d.repo && …} guard: the name, with no statement of what was authenticated or on what evidence.
focus: Whether each variant records a trade name or a token of the actual substance; whether the design has any procedure for the named absence of the specified repository rather than a silent swap; at what point in the handling chain a mapping is authenticated against real material rather than against its label; and what reads as a confident zero even when the mapping is entirely correct.
name: fd-materiamedica-substitution
persona: Apply the perspective of a dispensing practitioner in a text-based drug tradition who buys crude drugs from dealers, cannot trust a single label in the market, and keeps a retained sample of every batch on a back shelf. Such a person's first instinct on being handed anything is to break it, look at the cross-section, smell it and taste it — because the name on the sack is the cheapest part of the transaction and the first thing a supplier changes. They know that the drug named in the text is not necessarily the drug their teacher used; that an unavailable drug has a proper named substitute and that dispensing one without saying so is a distinct offence from dispensing an adulterated one; and that a preparation which has been powdered can never be authenticated again by anyone. They are unimpressed by paperwork and interested only in whether the substance in front of them is what the prescription means.
review_areas: Trade name versus material token. All four variants store a URL, and canon() at scripts/fidelity-dryrun.mjs:27-34 folds transport, .git suffix, trailing slash and case down to org/name — which is still a name, only a tidier one. Determine whether the fifth option is to store or derive an anchor to the substance itself (the root-commit SHA is the obvious candidate, and is already the discriminator the plan's own ambiguity table implicitly relies on when it says uncrancher has an unrelated root commit). Rule on where such an anchor lives: written into frontmatter by the admin form, or derived once and cached outside the content files, and what each choice costs against .voicepaths' strict gate over src/content/projects/**/*.md.

The absence procedure. Enumerate the ways a declared repository stops being available — archived, made private, deleted, transferred to another org, split in two, absorbed into a monorepo — and for each, state what each of A, B, C and D can record. The question is not when the change happened but whether a substitute may be dispensed at all and whether the record is obliged to say that it is a substitute. Note that unc-rancher already sits in the hardest version of this case: its own body places its code at solwend/apps/uncrancher, a subdirectory of another item's monorepo, which no whole-repository URL can express under any variant.

Where authentication happens in the chain. The admin write path at src/pages/admin/edit/[collection]/[slug].astro:104 is a single <input type="url"> that accepts any syntactically valid URL; the edit API already constructs an Octokit client for the commit itself. Identify the cheapest intake test that reads the material rather than the label — fetching the repository's root commit or its existence at write time — and say which variants can carry that test's result forward and which discard it. Distinguish an intake test from a periodic re-check: this lens is about the moment the material is accepted, not about a re-observation cadence.

The assay's marker set. scripts/fidelity-dryrun.mjs:16-20 counts a commit only if its author email is one of three listed identities, and lines 100-109 return an empty list on any git failure. A correct mapping to a real, active repository can therefore read zero because the work was committed under a fourth identity. Rule on whether this is a schema question at all — it may belong entirely to the measurement layer — and if any part of it is a schema question, say which variant could carry it and what it would cost. Do not design the reporting of the resulting state.

The label that outlives the jar. GitHub redirects renamed repositories, so a stored URL keeps resolving after a rename or transfer while pointing at material that may no longer be the same project, and a freed name can be reclaimed by an unrelated account. Assess which variants can detect that the substance behind a still-resolving name has changed, and state plainly whether a resolving URL is evidence of anything at all under each variant.

Adulteration versus substitution versus absence as distinct states. For each of A, B, C and D, say which of the three the shape can express and which two it collapses into one. Pay particular attention to arrays: an array that carries the right repository plus an unrelated one produces a larger, more confident number than the right repository alone, which is adulteration reading as potency rather than as a fault. Confine this to what the stored shape can and cannot distinguish.

One dispenser's labor. The plan's edit-count column prices migration in files touched. Reprice the recommended option in intake work: what must be done by hand once per item, what happens automatically on every build, and what must be redone whenever a repository moves. Any recommendation whose authentication step requires the dispenser to remember to do something is a recommendation that will decay to the current state within a season, and the review should say so.

severity_examples.condition: Applies when every stored value is a label and no part of the record is derived from repository content.
severity_examples.scenario: The recommended variant stores only names — URLs, or canonicalized org/name tokens — with nothing derived from the repositories themselves, so a rename, transfer or reclaimed name inside the measurement window leaves a mapping that still resolves, still parses, and now points at different material. The item reports a plausible days-touched figure computed from the wrong substance, and no check anywhere in the system can contradict it.

severity_examples.condition: Applies to any variant with no way to mark an entry as a declared substitute or as knowingly unavailable.
severity_examples.scenario: A repository is archived, made private or deleted, and the only available response under the chosen variant is to edit the mapping to point somewhere else or to leave it pointing at nothing. Either way the published record shows no evidence that a substitution or a loss occurred, so a stand-in repository's activity is reported as the item's own with the same confidence as an unbroken mapping.

severity_examples.condition: Applies when no stage between the admin form and the published number reads the actual repository.
severity_examples.scenario: The mapping is accepted at the counter on syntax alone — a valid URL for a repository that does not exist, or exists under a different owner — and every downstream stage treats it as authenticated material. The error becomes undetectable at the first aggregation, because a repository that resolves to no checkout is indistinguishable in the day-set from one that had no qualifying commits.

severity_examples.condition: Applies when the review scopes the failure mode to wrong mappings only.
severity_examples.scenario: The design is judged solely on mapping correctness, so the case where a correct mapping still reads zero — work committed under an identity outside the assay's marker set, or a repository present on neither machine — is never considered, and the recommendation claims a guarantee against silent zeros that it does not provide.

severity_examples.condition: Applies to A, B and C where multiplicity is permitted without an admission standard.
severity_examples.scenario: An array-capable variant is recommended without a rule about what may go in the array, so an item accumulates a genuine repository plus a loosely related one and reports a larger figure than either alone. The mixture is undetectable after aggregation, and the public page shows a number with no account of what went into it.

source_domain: Pre-modern materia medica and crude-drug authentication — Ayurvedic, Chinese and Unani dispensing, where one drug name in a prescription denotes different plants in different provinces and different centuries; where a drug that cannot be had has a named, textually authorized substitute (abhava pratinidhi dravya) that must be declared rather than quietly swapped in; where the dealer's word and the jar's label are worth nothing and the material is authenticated by breaking the root open and reading its cross-section, snap, odour and taste; and where a retained voucher specimen of the actual batch is kept so that a question raised years later can be settled against the substance instead of against the paperwork.
success_hints: Check the substance yourself before reasoning about it: run git -C ~/projects/solwend rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD and the same for ~/projects/uncrancher. The roots are a3a321bc and e88d83af — unrelated — which settles the plan's headline ambiguity by material in one command, and tells you what a voucher is worth here.

Read scripts/fidelity-dryrun.mjs:16-20 before ruling on whether the mapping is the only silent-zero vector. The IDENTITIES set is three email addresses; ask what happens to an item whose real work carries a fourth.

Open src/pages/admin/edit/[collection]/[slug].astro:104 and confirm what the counter actually accepts before proposing any intake test — a test that cannot be performed by the tool in the dispenser's hand is not a proposal.

Test the absence procedure against one concrete case rather than in general: mistakeknot/solwend is archived next month. State exactly what each of A, B, C and D can record, and what a reader of the public page would see.
Confirm whether data/repo-map.json exists before pricing variant D — scripts/fidelity-dryrun.mjs:57 already reads it if present, which is a different situation from a sidecar that must be invented.

State the fifth option as something a dispenser does — what is checked, when, by what tool, and what is retained — not as a principle. If it requires writing anything into the repositories themselves, say so explicitly, because that is a different and more expensive craft than retaining a voucher on your own shelf.
task_context: The repository is a personal site (Astro + TypeScript) whose slate of projects is scored by a funded-attention fidelity metric that reads commit activity per item. The target under review is docs/plans/2026-08-18-repo-schema-variants.md. Four variants for expressing an item-to-repository mapping in projectSchema have been prototyped and measured (A union repo:str|str[], B repos:str[] only, C repo+repos, D unchanged+sidecar). Find the options these four do NOT represent, and stress-test all of them against the real failure mode this field exists to prevent: a slate item silently reading zero days-touched because its mapping was wrong, missing, ambiguous, or stale. Consider identity-stability (repos get renamed, forked, split, archived; GitHub URLs are not stable identifiers), multi-machine reality (Clavain + zklw, same repo under different directory names, ssh vs https remotes), auditability (the site must publicly render what it measures), and the admin write path. Recommend one, with the tradeoff that decides it. Severity ladder for findings: P0 = would corrupt or block the whole design; P1 = must fix before implementing; P2 = degrades quality; P3 = polish. Anchor findings to concrete paths — the plan file, src/lib/schemas.ts, src/pages/projects/[slug].astro, src/pages/admin/edit/[collection]/[slug].astro, scripts/fidelity-dryrun.mjs, proto.cjs, or the content files under src/content/projects/.
